conventions.units: SI for geometry, permeability and potentials; mM for concentrations; fmol for amounts; 1 mM in 1 pL is 1 fmol
conventions.activity_coefficients: 1 (ideal solution): concentrations stand for activities everywhere, including in every free energy
conventions.charge_anchor_rule: cell: fixed_charge_equivalent_fmol = C_total V0 / CHARGE_PER_FMOL - sum_i z_i n_i; initial_charge_C = CHARGE_PER_FMOL (fixed_charge_equivalent_fmol + sum_i z_i n_i) = C_total V0. Extracellular nodes (bath, local): fixed_charge_equivalent_fmol = - sum_i z_i n_i; initial_charge_C = 0 (the cleft_egg pattern). C_total is the sum of the patches' capacitances
conventions.sign_convention: V is the cell's inside potential minus the outside node's potential; N is the inside end, P the outside end of every population and route

temperature_K.basis: top of the 14-18 C housing range stated in the 2013 Methods; impalement temperature unstated

preparation_card.location: validation-side data (cells.preparation_card@1, validator in validation/); the world definition cites this id in its provenance
preparation_card.stage: Nieuwkoop-Faber 15 for the voltage targets; the ion set was measured at cleavage stages (declared stage-transfer assumption)

geometry.basis: radius and capacitance nominal (no source read; 1 uF/cm2 is the conventional bilayer value); the checks are scale-free except the diffusion time of C8

species_notes: A (impermeant anion, assumed, set by electroneutrality) and B (butyrate) need no standard potential: a transported or impermeant anion needs none (kinds owner); every species has an initial amount at every node, a permeability entry (0 if impermeant) on every patch and a material_balance_atol_fmol entry

primary.why: the primary microelectrode measurement (Gillespie 1983, abstract); the second-hand 2016 table's K = 51 mM is below the level at which the same source reports embryos dying, and its Na = 38 mM has no stage; Cl = 30 mM is the 128-cell value, nearest to stage 15

bracket_Cl_high.why: the authors' quoted value and the egg-to-4-cell value

bracket_second_hand_table.why: Chernet et al. 2016, Table 1, cited there to Gillespie; stage unknown

bath.basis: Na 9.9, K 0.2 from the 2016 table; Cl 10.1 chosen to keep the ions neutral without the omitted Ca (0.3) and Mg (0.2); the 2013 text says 10 mM and the 2016 table 11.1

bath_70Cl.cation_options: primary: a sodium salt (Na 69.8 mM, shown); alternative: an inert monovalent cation Ch of 59.9 mM added as a sixth species (the paper does not state the cation); both are run and the verdict reported for each

bath_butyrate_dose.note: exposure time unpublished; uptake claims state their time

local.basis: Gillespie mid-blastula intercellular Na 91, K 4, Cl 59 mM; A 36 mM is the derived balancing anion; Ca omitted; volume nominal

face.basis: cleft_egg's pattern (a finite node with one face to the held bath); free-solution diffusivities as cleft_egg uses for Na, K, Cl; B's is nominal; A is impermeant to the face by declaration; geometry nominal

pump.availability: 0 in C1-C4, C5 as stated, 1 in C7 pump runs

membranes.note: the K leak sits on its own patch because the Kir route's host patch must have zero constant-field permeability for K

membranes.availability_schedule: 0 or 1 per arm (the Kir4.1 arm is 1)
0 (control) or 1 (GlyR F99A, constitutively open); no channel population, no ivermectin
membranes.note: Cl-only patch; Cl- cannot be a channel population on main

kir_route.kind: cells.passive_routes@1 (a new route law; a version 2 or one more dispatched name, the kinds owner's file)

sourcing.v_half_and_slope: nominal, no source: no open-access source with Kir4.1 numbers was found
sourcing.form: the sqrt(K_o) scaling and E_K-referenced rectification are the standard description of inward rectifiers (historical primary literature not read)

symporter_v1.orientation: N = inside end; forward cycle imports

capacity_fmol_per_s.vito_c_arm: 0.01 x f_VitoC with f_VitoC in [0,1] a free declared factor of that arm, grid 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75; folded into capacity_fmol_s, never the form

symporter_v1.sourcing: n_Na = 2 rests on the Coady et al. 2007 abstract for lactate and propionate (SMCT1, human SLC5A8); butyrate and the Xenopus ortholog are not covered, so n = 2 is an assumption. K_Na, hill_Na, K_B and the capacity: NO SOURCE, nominal placeholders

states: S3 Na2 B bound, outward facing
S4 Na2 B bound, inward facing
symporter_v2.electric_distance_rule: q_e is the charge (in units of e) moved from P toward N by traversing edge e forward, a fraction of the field; with a symmetric barrier zeta_forward = -0.5 q_e and zeta_backward = +0.5 q_e, so zeta_forward - zeta_backward = -q_e; the rate of an edge is k0 prod a^order exp(zeta psi), a = c / 1000 mM, psi = F V / RT
symporter_v2.charge_sum_check: sum of q_e = 0.2+0.2-0.1+0.4-0.5+0.4+0.4+0 = 1.0 = n - 1, the charge moved P to N per cycle (each ion's displacement sums to 1: Na 0.2+0.4+0.4 per ion over its edges, B 0.1+0.4+0.5)
symporter_v2.detailed_balance_check: product of forward k0 = 1e5*1e5*1e5*90*200*200*200*30 = 2.16e25; product of backward k0 = 3e3*3e3*10*12*1e5*1e5*1e5*20 = 2.16e25; the constants are those of a transport-only cycle (no free energy source), so the ratio is exactly 1
symporter_v2.sourcing: NO SOURCE for any constant: the constants and electric distances are nominal and consistent (detailed balance, charge), not literature; Gopal et al. 2004, cited by the 2013 paper for voltage-dependent uptake, was not read

junction.basis: nominal (about 5 nS); the gate is inert: minimum_open_fraction 1.0 parses (the @3 owner) and with initial_gate 1.0 keeps the gate exactly 1 inside the law's voltage domain |V| <= 0.120 V; the BETSE-derived rate equations decide nothing

two_cell_P2: two cells of the geometry above, cell_2 differing per claim only as C5 states; each cell has its own patches; both face the same outside node

execution.note: at moderate steps the energy check can refuse the small local node (FR-18); X2 is the opt-in for registered runs

sources_not_found: leak permeabilities for an embryonic cell (the oocyte values are placeholders)
local node volume and face geometry
P_GlyR and the F99A expression level
